verdict.rationale: Bento documents a public REST API covering subscribers, events, broadcasts, chat and data deletion. The docs include named endpoints (POST /batch/subscribers, GET /fetch/search, POST /batch/events), Basic-auth conventions, an error-diagnosis guide, an endpoint reference browser and a Postman collection. Official SDKs in many languages, a CLI, and a hosted MCP server build on top of the API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API's reliability and coverage (the community evidence only praises pricing and general experience).
